acceptance: The manifest is reproducible byte for byte, lists 29 files and 924 primitive digests with a root, is Ed25519 signed over a domain-separated canonical body, and any tamper, key misuse, unlisted or missing file is a hard failure.

positive.fixture: the committed manifest verifies and rebuilds byte for byte

negative.fixture: every covered file byte flip, signature edits, untrusted or revoked keys, lying but signed manifests and substituted trust fail

regression.command: cargo run --quiet --manifest-path compiler/Cargo.toml --locked -p vsf-registry -- manifest verify .

security_and_source_permissions: Registry data carries no credentials; no real source app was observed, and source-account permissions stay outside the registry.
performance_memory_storage: A full debug-build verification (signature, 29 file digests, witnesses, 924 primitive digests) measured 0.19 s. Adds ed25519-compact (MIT, no dependencies).
known_limitations: Only a public development key exists; release keys, rotation and an out-of-tree trust anchor belong to B14 and B20
